description: This file contains unit tests for the USB mass storage functionality, including device mount/unmount events, device list retrieval, and partition info, using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks.

classes.name: USBMassStorageNotificationHandler
classes.description: Implements the notification interface for USB mass storage events, handling device mounted and unmounted events, and synchronization for test assertions.
